title: Self-hosted gVisor systrap execution: implementation and real acceptance
title_es: Ejecución propia con gVisor systrap: implementación y pruebas reales
status: Implemented and validated with disposable accounts; production accounts not migrated

tests.note: Discovery preceded addition of one separately executed compiler/Node acceptance case. Skipped cases require explicit runtime/root/storage opt-in.

tests.command: sudo env FENIX_GVISOR_TESTS=1 FENIX_GVISOR_MANIFEST=PINNED_MANIFEST python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/isolation -p test_gvisor_acceptance.py -v

initial_failures_and_fixes.issue: Browser configuration was copied before the fixture supplied its seccomp path.
initial_failures_and_fixes.fix: Runtime default is a class attribute; the adapter preserves the existing shared configuration object.

initial_failures_and_fixes.issue: The upstream OCI seccomp translator ignores errnoRet and returns EPERM for clone3 instead of the intended ENOSYS; glibc thread creation failed in the relay and browser.
initial_failures_and_fixes.fix: A trusted startup/exec gate adds native BPF that keeps clone3 denied with ENOSYS and checks that result. Existing OCI and host filters remain enabled; no privileged or no-sandbox fallback was introduced.
initial_failures_and_fixes.verification: Dedicated real test proves threads work while clone3 and unauthorized namespace creation remain denied. Private relay and Chromium then pass.

not_claimed: Deployment or migration of production accounts.
ARM64 runtime acceptance; this host is x86_64.
Full LibreOffice/multimedia image build or application acceptance; existing tenant image was used.
Adversarial sandbox-escape audit, multi-tenant saturation/fairness, reboot/failover drills or latency benchmarks.
RAM snapshots, suspended-process restoration, live migration, replicated storage, Windows desktops or GPU support.
operational_notes: Omitted backend now selects gVisor and fails closed if the pinned runtime is missing. Explicit OCI or optional Kata configurations remain available without automatic fallback.
gVisor hard memory limits include runtime overhead. Guest cgroups are virtual; enforcement was inspected on the host.
The host execution service, Docker, gateway registry, runtime assets and native Fenix file/document tools remain trusted.
The temporary runtime and downloaded archive were removed after validation; installation remains an explicit deployment step.
resumen_es: Se cambió el backend predeterminado a gVisor systrap sin KVM. Pasaron 45 pruebas de política, 15 casos reales de gVisor y una regresión OCI. Se corrigieron la configuración del navegador y la compatibilidad de hilos conservando seccomp y el sandbox de Chromium. La configuración temporal se retiró y Docker se restauró. No se migraron cuentas reales.
